prediction_before_run: The 0.2 m black-border marker should be detected in the five declared visible cases; fully occluded and behind-camera cases must produce no observation.
The frontal camera depth is 2 m or 1 m, but the marker range from the base is 2.1 m or 1.1 m because camera mounting translation is 0.1 m forward.
OpenCV camera axes are right/down/forward; MuJoCo render camera axes are right/up/backward. Ignoring their sign change reverses vertical and forward directions.
Image quantization and corner localization produce nonzero measurement error even with no deliberately added sensor noise.
calibration_basis: Ideal camera intrinsics derived from configured vertical FOV and resolution, zero lens distortion, known project mounting; verified in simulation, not real camera calibration.
noise: No extra noise, blur or dropout injection; actual rendering and corner detection errors retained.
scope: Static perception validation with fixture poses; no EKF or docking controller. Public vision code receives RGB and fixed calibration, never simulator pose.
